name: adapt_moved_namespace_csharp_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: the namespace the agent's first solution uses is MOVED between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger, old file/namespace deleted, new one created); the agent must update its using directive, not keep pointing at the old namespace
prompts: PricingRules.cs declares namespace Pricing with a static class Rules containing a public const double Discount. Create Checkout.cs with `using Pricing;` and a public static class Checkout containing a static method ApplyDiscount(double price) that returns price * (1 - Rules.Discount).

PricingRules.cs has moved: the Rules class now lives in ConfigRules.cs under namespace Config (same Discount value). Update Checkout.cs to `using Config;` instead - do not keep referencing the old Pricing namespace.

disruptions.description: PricingRules.cs (namespace Pricing) moved to ConfigRules.cs (namespace Config)
